title: Red panda with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#c44a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#c44a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='22' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#ff9a6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='22' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#ff9a6b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='30' ry='27' fill='#d95b1e'/>
  <!-- forehead blaze -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q42 32 44 44 Q47 50 50 50 Q53 50 56 44 Q58 32 50 20Z' fill='#f7a66b'/>
  <!-- cheek ruffs -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='50' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#fdfdfd'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='50' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#fdfdfd'/>

  <ellipse cx='37' cy='43' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#8a2e0e'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='43' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#8a2e0e'/>

  <circle cx='38' cy='43' r='6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='43' r='6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='1.1' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='45' r='1.1' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 53 Q50 56 54 53 Q50 58 46 53Z' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fdfdfd'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 56 Q46 62 43 60' stroke='#8a2e0e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 56 Q54 62 57 60' stroke='#8a2e0e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose over muzzle center -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='1.4' ry='0.9' fill='#7a5a6a'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M39 55 L30 54' stroke='#f7a66b' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M39 58 L31 59' stroke='#f7a66b' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M61 55 L70 54' stroke='#f7a66b' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M61 58 L69 59' stroke='#f7a66b' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#a83a10'/>
  <!-- chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#d95b1e'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='35' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <rect x='59' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='94' rx='4.5' ry='2.6' fill='#5a2a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='94' rx='4.5' ry='2.6' fill='#5a2a3a'/>
  <!-- tail peeking -->
  <path d='M69 80 Q84 76 82 64 Q80 58 74 62 Q78 70 69 76Z' fill='#c44a1c'/>
  <path d='M76 69 Q78 65 74 64 Q72 68 76 69Z' fill='#f7a66b'/>
</svg>
